# Kbd

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

typography and layout · tier 2 · beta · renders on the server and ships no client JavaScript.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

To name a key the reader presses, inside running text or beside a menu item. It is one
`<kbd>` with a keycap look and no props of its own; it is not a control, so it takes no
focus and has no states.

```tsx
<p>Press <Kbd><Svg icon={command} label="Command" /></Kbd> <Kbd>K</Kbd> to open the command palette.</p>
```

A combination is sibling keys separated by a space, with no group part and no "+". For the
nested form of the HTML spec, wrap the keys in a plain `<kbd>` yourself. An icon inside a
key is an `<Svg>` at its `1em` default, so it follows the key's own text.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { Kbd } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

This component takes no design props of its own.

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
